page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.12xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at a base frequency of 3.2 GHz. The instance provisions 48 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, as the configuration includes zero GPUs.

Storage architecture relies entirely on remote networked block storage, as the instance includes no local ephemeral storage drives. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 25 Gbps, supporting standard multi-node synchronization and high-bandwidth network communication. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC-level network address translation or elastic IP attachment for external traffic.

With its 48 dedicated compute cores and 192.0 GB of memory, the ecs.g9i.12xlarge presents an efficient operational profile for enterprise workloads that require balanced compute and memory capacity without paying for idle local disks or accelerators. The configuration fits multi-tier enterprise web serving, backend application servers, container clusters, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, and distributed data processing systems.
